global_style: An elegant, editorial-style presentation utilizing minimalist layouts, Morandi color palettes, and overlapping geometric accents for a boutique aesthetic.

identity_anchors: Overlapping solid-color rectangular plates intersecting with images or text.
High-contrast typographic pairing (large serif headers, clean sans-serif body).
Prominent use of oversized, low-opacity decorative numerals.
Generous asymmetric whitespace framing content blocks.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
